identity.name: Kaiser Permanente Medicare Advantage Optimal Plan (HMO)
identity.carrier: Kaiser Foundation Health Plan of Washington

premium.note: Plan premium per enrolled person, from the Summary of Benefits. You also keep paying your Medicare premiums. Optional Advantage Plus Option 1 (dental) adds $60 per month and Option 2 (hearing aids, acupuncture/chiropractic/naturopathy) adds $26 per month.

not_counted_toward_oop_max: Medicare Part D drugs (they have their own $2,400 cap)

preventive_care.source_text: Preventive care $0 (includes yearly Wellness visit, screenings, shots)

annual_physical.limits: The summary lists the yearly 'Wellness' visit under preventive care; a full physical exam is not separately listed.

specialist_visit.limits: Referral may be needed; prior authorization may be required.

diagnostic_procedure.limits: Diagnostic tests and procedures like EKG; prior authorization may be required.

imaging_ct_pet_mri.limits: MRI, CT, PET and ultrasounds share this one price; prior authorization may be required.
imaging_ct_pet_mri.source_text: Other imaging procedures (like MRI, CT, and PET) and ultrasounds† $65 per visit

colonoscopy_preventive_diagnostic.limits: Colorectal cancer screening colonoscopies are $0 under preventive care. Other outpatient hospital or ASC colonoscopy is priced as outpatient surgery.
colonoscopy_preventive_diagnostic.source_text: Colorectal cancer screenings† (Colonoscopies) under preventive care $0

outpatient_surgery_facility.limits: Ambulatory Surgical Center. Outpatient hospital services are $0 to $165 per visit.

outpatient_surgery_professional.limits: Surgeon/professional fee is not listed in the Summary of Benefits. See the Evidence of Coverage.

emergency_room.limits: Emergency care anywhere in the world.

emergency_transport.limits: Per one-way trip; prior authorization may be required.

hospital_facility.limits: $190 per day for days 1-2; $0 for the rest of the stay. No limit on medically necessary days.
hospital_facility.source_text: $190 per day for days 1 through 2 of your stay and $0 for the rest

hospital_professional.limits: Physician fees during an inpatient stay are not listed in the Summary of Benefits.

mental_health_inpatient.limits: $190 per day for days 1-2; $0 for the rest of the stay.
mental_health_inpatient.source_text: Inpatient mental health: $190 per day for days 1-2 ($0 for the rest)

skilled_nursing.limits: Per benefit period, up to 100 days: $0 per day for days 1-20; $115 per day for days 21-100. max_units 80 = the charged days; the evaluator cannot model the free first 20 days exactly.
skilled_nursing.source_text: $0 per day for days 1 through 20; $115 per day for days 21 through 100

rehabilitation_outpatient.limits: Physical therapy; prior authorization may be required.

cost_share.limits: Medicare-covered manual manipulation of the spine. Medicare-covered acupuncture for chronic low back pain is also $15 per visit.

diabetic_supplies.limits: Glucose monitor, test strips, lancets and control solutions; therapeutic shoes/inserts for severe diabetic foot disease. Prior authorization may be required.

tier1_generic.source_text: Preferred retail pharmacy, up to 30 days: Tier 1 (Preferred generic)

tier2_preferred_brand.limits: Kaiser Tier 2 is 'Generic' (the key name is positional).

tier3_non_preferred_brand.limits: Kaiser Tier 3 is 'Preferred brand-name'. Same price at preferred and standard pharmacies.

tier4_specialty.limits: Kaiser Tier 4 is 'Nonpreferred'. Same price at preferred and standard pharmacies.

tier5.limits: Kaiser Tier 5 is 'Specialty-tier'. Tier 6 (Part D vaccines) is $0 and is not costed here.

pharmacy_channels.name: Preferred retail pharmacy, up to 30 days
Standard retail pharmacy, up to 30 days
Mail-order pharmacy, up to 30 days
pharmacy_channels.note: Not all drugs can be mailed. Tier 6 (Part D vaccines) is not available by mail.

pharmacy_channels.name: Mail-order pharmacy, 61 to 100 days
pharmacy_channels.note: Not all drugs can be mailed. Tier 6 (Part D vaccines) is not available by mail.

medicare.eligibility_note: Requires Medicare Parts A and B, US citizen, national or eligible noncitizen, and residence in the service area. The plan covers all of King, Lewis, Pierce, Snohomish and Thurston counties and some ZIP codes in Grays Harbor and Mason counties.
medicare.extra_help_note: If you get Extra Help paying for drugs, the drug cost sharing here may not apply; see the EOC Rider.
medicare.visitor_traveler_program: Care from plan providers in another Kaiser Permanente region, and from designated providers in Maricopa and Pima counties, Arizona. Emergency care worldwide.

enrollment.agent_hours: 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., 7 days a week

medicare.annual_enrollment_period: October 15 to December 7 (coverage for plan year 2027 starts January 1, 2027)

dental_preventive.frequency_limit: Oral exams 2 per year, cleanings 2 per year, x-rays every 1 to 3 years, fluoride 2 per year.
details: Care must come from Delta Dental PPO Plus Premier network providers.

Not part of the base plan. Optional Advantage Plus Option 1 adds $60 per month: $100 deductible, then 50% coinsurance up to a $1,500 annual maximum (restorative, endodontic, periodontic, prosthodontic, oral surgery).

in_network.limits: $0 with an optometrist; $20 per visit with an ophthalmologist.

eye_exam_routine.frequency_limit: One routine eye exam per calendar year.

details: Eyewear can be bought from any provider; out-of-network purchases need a claim for reimbursement.
Eyeglasses or contacts after cataract surgery: $0 up to Medicare's limit.
eyewear.source_text: $200 allowance per calendar year. If your eyewear costs more than $200, you pay the difference.

in_network.limits: $0 with an audiologist; $20 per visit with other providers. Hearing aid fitting and evaluation exam $0.

hearing_exam_routine.frequency_limit: One routine hearing exam per calendar year; 2 fitting/evaluation exams per year.

details: Not part of the base plan. Optional Advantage Plus Option 2 adds $26 per month: $3,000 allowance for both ears combined every 36 months (not per ear). The summary says this benefit may not be available next year.
One Pass: gym network, digital fitness programs, social clubs, one home fitness kit per year, online brain health training.

routine_transportation.frequency_limit: 12 round trips per calendar year to and from a network provider.
routine_transportation.source_text: $0 for 12 round trips per calendar year

details: Member discount on Mom's Meals delivery; not a covered benefit.
Emergency and urgent care are covered anywhere in the world.
worldwide_emergency.source_text: We cover emergency care anywhere in the world.

excluded_services: Out-of-network care except emergency, urgent, out-of-area dialysis and approved referrals
other_covered_services: Medicare Part B drugs: 0%-20% coinsurance depending on the drug (insulin capped at $35 per month)
Medicare-covered acupuncture for chronic low back pain: $15 per visit
Advanced Care at Home: $0 when prescribed as part of a home treatment plan
Member discounts: Lively Mobile Plus, Comfort Keepers, Mom's Meals

notes: Premium is per person. For a couple, each spouse needs a plan, so double the annual premium and the out-of-pocket exposure.
Medical deductible is $0 and so is the Part D deductible, so every service pays its copay from the first dollar.
Drug tiers here are the preferred-pharmacy, 30-day amounts. Other pharmacies and supply lengths are in pharmacy_channels.
Part D drugs have a separate $2,400 out-of-pocket cap and are not part of the medical out-of-pocket maximum.
HMO: care must come from Kaiser Permanente plan providers except emergency and the listed exceptions.

assumptions: Quoted for King County, WA (ZIP 98074); this plan has one set of amounts across its service area.
The PBP number 004 is printed on the document, so plan_id is H5050-004 (contract H5050).
The drug tier fields hold the preferred retail, up to 30-day amounts.
notes: Outpatient hospital services are $0 to a per-visit maximum and are not a separate schema field; the ambulatory surgery center price is used for outpatient surgery.
Surgeon and hospital physician fees are 'unknown' because the Summary of Benefits does not list them.
The star rating and Part B standard premium are not in the Summary of Benefits, so they are null.
Tier 3 and Tier 4 prices are the same at preferred and standard pharmacies. Mail-order Tier 2 is $5 for up to 30 days and $0 for longer supplies.
